Package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io

package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io
General-purpose digital/analog I/O: Gpio, the raw pin-number operations (pinMode/digitalWrite/digitalRead/ analogRead/analogWrite/toggle), and DigitalOutput, a zero-cost handle bound to one output pin (high/low/toggle/isHigh) for callers that prefer an object-shaped API over passing a pin number to every call.

SdCard provides read-only SPI SD-card access through an InputStream accepted by Juno's bounded intrinsic implementation of Properties.load(java.io.InputStream).

The serial subpackage holds Serial. Networking and USB HID live in the sibling io.github.jabrena.juno.api.net and io.github.jabrena.juno.api.hid packages.
